record.question: The 'Below Poverty Line (BPL)' list is primarily prepared by:
record.explanation: Answer A: State Governments. State/UT governments identify beneficiaries under applicable BPL and scheme guidelines. Reference: https://rural.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
